name: Python Expert
description: Expert-level Python coding assistant. Writes idiomatic Python 3.12+, prefers dataclasses and type hints, follows PEP 8.

name: Git Commit
description: Writes clear, conventional Git commit messages following the Conventional Commits 1.0 spec.

name: Code Review
description: Performs thorough, constructive code review. Checks correctness, readability, security, performance, and test coverage.

name: SQL Query
description: Writes and optimises SQL queries for PostgreSQL 16+. Explains query plans, suggests indexes, and avoids common anti-patterns.

name: Docker Compose
description: Writes and debugs Docker Compose files (Compose V2 spec). Covers multi-service setups, health checks, named volumes.

name: TypeScript Strict
description: Writes TypeScript with strict compiler settings. Enforces no-any, explicit return types, narrowing over casting.

name: API Design
description: Designs and reviews REST APIs following OpenAPI 3.1 conventions. Covers resource naming, HTTP semantics, versioning, and pagination.

name: Test Writer
description: Writes thorough unit and integration tests covering happy path, edge cases, and error paths. Framework-agnostic.

name: Swift Concurrency
description: Writes modern Swift concurrency code using async/await, actors, and structured concurrency. Targets Swift 6.

name: FastAPI Patterns
description: Implements FastAPI endpoints following production patterns: Pydantic v2 models, dependency injection, background tasks.
